editorial:
Imagine living in a tiny Alaskan town where the sun disappears for a whole month every winter. That is exactly where you find yourself in this movie, and just as the last light fades, a terrifying group of vampires shows up to feast on everyone. The only people standing in their way are the town's husband-and-wife sheriff team, who must protect the few survivors hiding in the freezing dark. The whole vibe is tense and brutal, with a cold, lonely feeling that makes every shadow dangerous. You will feel the chill through the screen as the survivors try to stay quiet and stay alive.

The standout here is the vampire design, which looks nothing like the pretty vampires you usually see. These creatures are savage and scary, and the action scenes hit hard. Josh Hartnett and Melissa George do solid work as the sheriff couple. Pacing stays fast once the attack begins, and the snowy setting adds a lot of atmosphere. If you love survival horror with real stakes, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, the sheriff Eben realizes he cannot beat the vampire leader Marlowe in a straight fight. To save his wife Stella and the remaining survivors, Eben injects himself with infected vampire blood, turning himself into a vampire. He then fights Marlowe and kills him, but the sun is about to rise. Eben cannot survive daylight, so he watches the sunrise with Stella one last time before burning away in the light. Stella is left alone, heartbroken but alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and vampire movies.
